title: 若駒ステークスにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the day of the Wakagoma Stakes, a race that will prepare us for the Classics ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio is not the least bit anxious—in fact, she can hardly wait to begin. She takes deep breaths so she won't get too carried away and slip up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to show the audience what a rising star can do, she dashes off full of excitement!
